prompt: Show the account-opening funnel by step and channel for the last 30 logical days.

results.text: Across the last 30 logical days, digital channels started 8,400 sessions, 5,460 applications were submitted (65.0% completion), 819 were referred to manual review (15.0% referral rate), and 4,368 were approved. Organic and paid_search behave similarly; branch_referral has a smaller volume but a slightly higher completion rate.

sql.command:
SELECT channel, SUM(sessions_started) AS sessions_started, SUM(applications_submitted) AS applications_submitted, SUM(referred_to_review) AS referred_to_review, SUM(applications_approved) AS applications_approved
FROM aa_digital_funnel
WHERE session_date > DATE_SUB((SELECT logical_time FROM demo_active_run WHERE singleton_id = 1), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY channel
